newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble stable in calm Monday trade.
newsitem.headline: Rouble stable in calm Monday trade.

text.p: The rouble was little changed and dealers said banks were closing their positions, maintaining the rouble's slow long-term downward trend, even though it was a few ticks higher on Monday.
roubles/dollar Dec 2 midday Dec 2 early Nov 29 close
"No big changes are happening today. Banks' quotes depend on their open positions," a Stolichny Bank dealer said. Bids and offers were in balance on the market.

A European Trade Bank dealer said: "The month-end has passed smoothly for the market as the rouble failed to strengthen this time. The general trend of the slow (dollar) rise, limited by the central bank, still dominates the market."
